verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a custom report builder, or any filtering or grouping of reports by class, location, or tag. The only related mention is that the Plus plan includes "classes". That shows class tracking exists, but it is an adjacent feature, not reporting by class dimension. The generic "generate reports" claims for MCP and CLI do not document dimensional grouping either.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can build custom reports filtered and grouped by class, location, or tag dimensions
